title: Editor crash
body: ### Tested versions Engine version: Godot Engine v4.5.1.stable.fedora (f62fdbde15035c5576dad93e586201f4d41ef0cb) ### System information Godot v4.5.1.stable (f62fdbde1) - Fedora Linux 43 (Workstation Edition) on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT (RADV GFX1201) - AMD Ryzen 9 5900X 12-Core Processor (24 threads) - 62.67 GiB memory ### Issue description In the past hour godot started crashing seemingly randomly. The new thing I am doing is configuring heavily nested resource.
